- Current MAP milestone: Legal review & MSA/DPA/SLA negotiation.

I've attached the MAP draft (Attachment: 20260225-Acme-MAP-draft.docx) that includes milestone owners and proposed turnaround times. Please review the Legal milestone section 	6 we want to align on who will own edits to MSA/DPA/SLA and expected review cycles so we can hold the 3/20 target.

Proposed responsibilities (high level):
- Redwood: provide MSA/DPA template + initial redline to reflect Redwood's data handling and SLA language; respond to customer redlines within 2 business days for straightforward items.
- Acme: provide consolidated legal redline package (or inline comments) and target internal review turnaround of 5-7 business days.
- If there are material changes (security/scope), allow an additional 3 business days for cross-team alignment.

Can you confirm who from Acme Legal will be the primary reviewer and whether procurement will need a formal PO before signature?

Appreciate the summary. A couple quick clarifying Qs from legal/procurement:

1) Who will do the initial redline? Will Redwood upload an MSA/DPA with your preferred language (so Acme can mark up), or do you expect Acme to start from our template?
2) Turnaround times: 2 business days from Redwood sounds tight for substantive legal asks. Can you clarify what you consider "straightforward items"?
3) Procurement: Acme typically requires a PO for any contract >$100k. We are under review on expected spend, but procurement should be in the loop.

Jane in legal (cc'd) will be the primary reviewer for contracts. If Redwood can provide an initial MSA/DPA redline, we'll consolidate and return within 5-7 business days assuming no material scope changes. If Redwood prefers us to start from our template, we can do that but it may add a day to the schedule.

I'll wait for your confirmation so we can update the MAP and lock the milestone owners.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Product, Acme Corp

Hi Sanjay / Jane 	6

Thanks for the quick reply. Confirming approach and proposed SLAs for legal milestone so we can update the MAP:

1) Initial redline ownership:
   - Redwood will upload our standard MSA + DPA + SLA templates with minimal customer-specific language pre-applied (pricing and scope). We do this to ensure the SLA/termination/KMS language reflects our operational practices.
   - Acme Legal may either (A) redline our templates, or (B) provide an Acme template and we will redline that. Both are fine 	6 process-wise it's cleaner if Redwood provides an initial redline so Acme has a clear baseline.

2) Turnaround times (proposed, to be captured in MAP):
   - Redwood initial redline (MSA/DPA/SLA): 2 business days after you confirm we should proceed with Redwood's template.
   - Acme consolidated redlines: 5-7 business days after receipt of Redwood redline (assuming no new security scope changes).
   - Redwood response to material security or scope changes: additional 2-3 business days for cross-team review.

3) MAP milestone fields to update:
   - Owner: Legal (Redwood) 	6 provide initial redline; Owner: Legal (Acme) 	6 review/return consolidated comments.
   - Acceptance criteria: Signed MSA + executed DPA; SLA agreed and documented in MAP; procurement PO received (if required).
   - Dependencies: SOC 2 Type II report (Redwood to provide link), KMS key-sharing plan (engineering contact), procurement PO.
   - Target close date for milestone: 2026-03-10 (this keeps contract LOE before the overall MAP close date of 3/20).

4) Escalation path: If legal redline cycles exceed 10 business days total or if a new security scope is introduced, escalate to the respective execs (Marissa / Sanjay) and pause MAP timeline until alignment.

Action items I will take after you confirm:
- Upload Redwood redline (MSA/DPA/SLA) to the shared Drive and update MAP owner column.
- Loop in engineering/security for KMS details (Vivek is cc'd).
- Confirm SOC 2 link in the MAP.

Please confirm by end of day whether you want Redwood to lead with our templates. If so, we will upload the redline and set the timelines above.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
